description: Erection of a single storey rooftop extension to the rear wing of an existing Class E office building, providing approximately 239.5sqm of additional floorspace, an associated external roof terrace and replacement plant enclosure, following demolition of an existing unauthorised plant enclosure; raising the rear wing from three to four storeys, subservient to the existing five-storey principal building.
